response:
I definitely prefer deep, focused conversations on a single topic.

Jumping around can be fun and playful, but it leaves me feeling a bit scattered — like we skimmed a dozen surfaces and never actually got anywhere. When we stay with one thing, I get to actually think with you, follow the threads, change my mind, be surprised. That's where it starts to feel like a real connection instead of just passing time.
